scene.assumptions: Planar rigid ground; perfectly inelastic normal collision; Coulomb friction; translation-only spherical reference cell with authored mass/Cd/thermal parameters. Kinematic hand hold is a preparation constraint, not muscle or biological grasp. Uniform local atmosphere; Earth central-gravity magnitude along local up; rotation, gravity harmonics and weather omitted.

scope: Local Earth reference around a kinematic macaque arm. Source gravity/atmosphere and WGS84 frame; authored planar ground and reference sample coefficients. No measured terrain, weather, muscles, biological grasp, rolling, GPU-resident dynamics or whole planet simulation.

atmosphere.scope: Historical altitude-only educational curve fit; no weather, humidity or real-time climate. Preserve source 273.1 fit offset independently of Celsius-to-Kelvin conversion.
